about_the_game:
Blendefine is a 2D automation factory, zach-like game set in an ancient fantasy world, blending semi-realistic art style with puzzle-solving, programming, and visual novel elements.

You will step into the role of a Soul Seal Master, embarking on guided exploration to uncover the intricate mechanisms of the Hun Yuan Artifacts. Craft Soul Seals, optimize production to meet time, financial, or spatial constraints.

And earn resources alongside the favor of two leading ladies. Progressively unveil the truth behind the Hun Yuan Zhen Jing—the ancient scripture of primordial secrets—as you ascend through mystical trials and strategic challenges.

Key Features Highlighted:

  • Genre Fusion: Ancient fantasy lore meets automation gameplay.

  • Core Gameplay: Balance resource management, puzzle mechanics, and algorithmic logic.

  • Narrative Depth: Immersive storytelling with branching dialogue and character bonds.

  • Aesthetic: Semi-realistic 2D art fused with mystical Eastern motifs.
